title: Where? The place before the verb

sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Say where you do something with the place before the verb: *A kertben olvasok.* To ask where, start with *Hol*: *Hol olvasol?* The place takes *-ban* or *-ben* by its vowels, as you know. *Otthon* (“at home”) takes no ending.

items.english: I am walking to the park.

sections.content: *Sétál* is a verb that can go with both questions. *A parkban sétálok* (answer to *Hol?*) means “I walk about in the park”. *A parkba sétálok* (answer to *Hová?*) means “I walk to the park”.
